info.title: ultrhand-mover
info.author: miyqwx
info.description: Move Ultrahand out so TOTK can run.
info.details: Some sysmodules stop certain games from launching. With Ultrahand or Mission Control installed, The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom can fail to run or crash Atmosphere\n\nThe usual workaround is to pull those folders out of atmosphere/contents by hand before playing, then drag them back afterwards. Ultrahand Mover does it for you from the console itself, with no PC and no SD card reader.
